query:
SELECT s.id AS "session_id!", l.created_at AS "created_at!"
                     FROM unnest($1::bigint[]) AS s(id)
                    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                          SELECT r.created_at
                            FROM requests.requests r
                           WHERE r.session_id = s.id
                           ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
                           LIMIT 1
                    ) l
